headline: Mass Protests Sweep France as Demonstrators Demand Higher Wages
summary: France faced widespread protests and transport disruptions as crowds demanding higher wages and student rights mobilized. The Interior Ministry estimated about 600,000 participants, while unions claimed nearly 1.6 million.
why: Labor strikes and mass civil unrest disrupt commercial activity, public transport, and supply chains across Europe's major economies, impacting business sentiment.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: Nationwide strikes and protests impair transport and business operations in France.
